verdict: Omnisend: Choose Omnisend when ecommerce email + SMS + push with Shopify-friendly workflows is the job and you want a strong Klaviyo alternative on contact pricing. Scores use the email-marketing editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Ecommerce multichannel email/SMS/push in one stack
Forever-free plan for small contact bases
weaknesses: Standard send caps push high-volume senders to Pro
Intro discounts complicate exact monthly floors
Not a sales CRM of record
bestFor: Ecommerce brands wanting email + SMS + push without Klaviyo-tier cost
Shopify-centric stores needing pre-built ecommerce workflows
Teams comparing multichannel owned-channel stacks on contact pricing
notIdealFor: Creators who only need a simple newsletter without ecommerce catalog data
Buyers who need the cheapest send-based ESP (prefer Brevo)
tradeoffs: Forever-free / trial entry vs paid feature unlocks
Core ESP breadth vs adjacent deliverability/verification specialization
recommendation: Choose Omnisend when ecommerce email + SMS + push with Shopify-friendly workflows is the job and you want a strong Klaviyo alternative on contact pricing. Compare Klaviyo for deeper attribution, Brevo for send-based value, ActiveCampaign for B2B automation, and Drip for ecommerce CRM/email peers.
